title: Quick generation
sampleText: こんにちは。これは音声合成の動作確認です。

emoji.title: Emoji palette
emoji.hint: Click to insert at the cursor. Repeating an emoji strengthens its effect.

caption.label: Caption (voice, emotion, manner)
caption.placeholder: Japanese, e.g. 落ち着いた、近い距離感の女性話者
caption.conflictHint: With reference audio, describe emotion and manner rather than the voice itself for stable results.

voice.label: Voice
voice.noneHint: No reference audio: the caption (or nothing) decides the voice.
voice.clipsHint: Several clean short clips of one speaker work best. They are joined from top to bottom (up to {{max}} s in total).
voice.clipsOver: Anything beyond {{max}} s is not used.
voice.embeddingHint: A .speaker.safetensors made with Speaker Inversion for the same base model.
voice.libraryHint: Choosing a voice loads its defaults (caption, parameters, seed, LoRA) into the form.
voice.libraryEmpty: The library has no voices yet. You can create them in Voice Studio.
voice.librarySummaryClips_one: A voice with {{count}} reference clip ({{seconds}} s).
voice.librarySummaryClips_other: A voice with {{count}} reference clips ({{seconds}} s).
voice.defaultsApplied: Its defaults were loaded when you chose it.

lora.label: LoRA adapter
lora.help: Folder of a trained LoRA adapter (with adapter_config.json). It is applied to this generation only, not merged into the model.

generate.needVoice: Choose a voice from the library.
generate.uploading: Waiting for reference uploads to finish.

candidates.title: Results
candidates.empty: Nothing generated yet. Enter some text and press Generate.
